examined_formations.title: CHINA_OPEN_SOURCE_REPUTATION_TO_PAID_HOSTED_AI_SERVICE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: On 2026-08-26 the BiliNote operator reported that the open-source project had passed 7,000 GitHub stars and that the accumulated recognition continued to send real visits to the hosted Bilinote Pro service.

From 2026-05-12 through 2026-08-26 the operator reported 5,402 registered users, 602 users with at least one payment, 674 paid orders and RMB 24,264.30 cumulative receipts; 282 subscriptions were active at the measurement date.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The current public BiliNote repository independently shows a live MIT-licensed project with roughly 7.3k stars, 900+ forks, hundreds of commits and an explicit link to the hosted Pro service.

The public repository and hosted site show that the operator controls the project identity, release surface and conversion path from open-source discovery to hosted service rather than relying only on paid lead buying.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The operator explicitly describes open source as a long-running acquisition machine: users download, deploy, ask questions, contribute feedback and recommend the project, after which a subset with higher-frequency needs chooses the Pro service.
The hosted service removes deployment, GPU/CUDA, ffmpeg, model-download and API-key friction that open-source users repeatedly reported.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is genuine non-commodity control for the incumbent operator: years of repository identity, stars, forks, community recognition and organic inbound cannot be cloned merely by copying the MIT code.

That same fact is an entry failure for a fresh independent operator. The decisive acquisition asset belongs to the existing project/operator and is not obtainable through a standardized channel on materially similar terms.
The underlying video-to-note capability is not scarce: current open-source and commercial substitutes expose the same broad video transcription, summarization and note-generation outcome.
The operator also states that updates, maintenance, customer service, content, channel operations and commercialization still require continuing input and is seeking deeper operating partners.
economic_signal: Participant-reported cumulative receipts were RMB 24,264.30 by 2026-08-26, with RMB 7,732.10 in June and RMB 6,909.20 in July; subscription revenue represented 89.6% of receipts.

External money motion is therefore proven at meaningful small-operator scale, but normalized margin is not proven because model, transcription, server, bandwidth, support and maintenance costs are not quantified.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: BiliNote itself is the incumbent owner of the examined reputation/inbound graph; a new operator does not receive that graph by forking the MIT code.
Current alternative tools and open-source projects offer Bilibili/YouTube video transcription, AI summaries and structured notes, so the product primitive does not independently protect the entrant.
The only evidenced scarce asset is the existing operator's historical reputation/distribution position.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CREATOR_AUDIENCE_TO_EXCLUSIVE_PLATFORM_CONTRACT
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: On 2026-08-28 a China creator reported roughly 300k Douyin followers, 80k Xiaohongshu followers, 70k Kuaishou followers and nearly 500k Bilibili followers after about six months of content production.
The creator reported signing a three-year Bilibili exclusive agreement, with Bilibili advertising work contributing about 70% of total self-media income.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Bilibili's current commercial authorization agreement documents creator-controlled video/account authorization inside the Huahuo commercial-order system and describes the data exposed to authorized advertisers.
Bilibili's official marketing materials document platform creator monetization programs in which eligible original creators can receive advertising revenue in addition to creation incentives.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The creator reported an exclusive incentive around RMB 40-50 per 10,000 seven-day video views, ordinary creation incentives of about RMB 1,000-2,000 and the ability to reach roughly RMB 10,000 monthly when advertising orders are available.
The same operator reported producing more than 130 topics in roughly six months and described personally sourcing topics from daily media consumption and current events.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The audience, account history and exclusive contract are strongly operator-specific and cannot be replicated by an equivalent entrant on demand.

They are also inseparable from the creator identity, repeated content output and Bilibili's platform allocation/contract decisions, so the decisive position is neither standardized entrant-acquirable nor founder-independent.
A generic agent can assist scripting and editing but cannot lawfully or commercially inherit the creator's identity, audience, trust or exclusive contract.
economic_signal: The participant reported Bilibili as the majority income source, an exclusive incentive linked to seven-day views, ordinary creation incentives and advertising orders that can make monthly income around RMB 10,000.
These are real external payments, but they are compensation for ongoing creator output and platform-owned distribution rather than a machine-delegatable operator margin.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Bilibili owns the recommendation, creator-incentive and commercial-order rails while the creator owns the account/content relationship subject to platform rules.
The exclusive contract is a bilateral platform-creator arrangement, not a generally callable supply or routing right available to a fresh operator.
The creator's accumulated follower graph is the scarce asset and is directly tied to recurring personal content production.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_OPERATOR_ACCUMULATED_SEO_SITE_TO_GLOBAL_SUBSCRIPTIONS
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: On 2026-08-10 a China independent developer reported that a seven-month-old tool site had exceeded USD 5,000 in monthly subscription revenue, with additional pay-as-you-go revenue and a small PayPal subscription tail.

The operator reported that a July infrastructure outage materially reduced Google search traffic and that much of the following effort went into restoring subscription traffic, directly linking the commercial flow to accumulated search visibility.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Google Search Central documents that search visibility depends on automated ranking systems using many page-level and site-wide signals and that rankings can change as the web and systems change.

Google also documents that paid or unnatural link schemes and scaled AI content created primarily to manipulate rankings can violate spam policies, so an SEO-derived position is partly governed by an external control plane rather than owned outright.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: At five months the operator reported about 490 Stripe subscribers plus roughly 20 PayPal subscribers and USD 3,300 monthly subscription revenue, while an SEO script published a multilingual article about every three days.

The operator also reported buying some backlinks earlier, paying USD 100 for a TikTok promotion, and receiving at least one organic outside recommendation; the later seven-month report says server and AI costs were roughly 20% of revenue.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The accumulated domain/content/link/ranking position has path dependence and therefore can become non-commodity for the current owner.

The exact site is deliberately undisclosed, so the claimed rankings, site identity and conversion surface cannot be independently verified; fail-closed rules prevent treating the incumbent's search position as proven operator control.

The operator states that the underlying product is easy to copy and originated from discovering a similar Product Hunt site, while the acquisition playbook includes reproducible automation, purchased links and paid promotion.
Search ranking is externally controlled and demonstrated operational fragility: one hosting outage caused a material traffic decline.
economic_signal: The operator reported monthly subscription revenue above USD 5,000 at seven months and server/AI costs around 20% of revenue, stronger gross economics than the other Scan 103 samples.
However the product/site identity is withheld and labor, payment fees, promotion, tax and traffic-recovery costs are not fully normalized, so the claimed margin cannot be independently audited.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current operator owns the domain/content deployment and subscription product but Google owns discovery ranking and can change or suppress visibility.
SEO execution itself is widely accessible and the operator describes automated multilingual publishing, paid backlinks and paid creator promotion rather than a unique right or closed supply.
Without the site identity there is no exact-incumbent, product-substitute or ranking-position verification sufficient to establish a fresh entrant wedge.
